lines.text: Isaiah sends Hezekiah the LORD's message, saying Sennacherib has mocked the Holy One of Israel, and Hezekiah had prayed.
Sennacherib boasts of cutting down Lebanon's cedars and drying up Egypt's streams, but the LORD planned it long ago.
The LORD will put His hook in Sennacherib's nose and send him back the way he came.
The LORD will defend Jerusalem for His own sake and Hezekiah's, and His angel strikes down 185,000 Assyrians.
Sennacherib returns to Babylon, where his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer kill him, and Esar-haddon reigns in his place.
